ledger.claim: The baseline no-show fee is chargeable only if all four POL-NS-01 conditions hold, and limb (c) fails on the driver's own telemetry. The pickup zone class is STANDARD (trip_record.pickup_zone_class), so the required continuous in-geofence dwell is 300 seconds, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix rather than from the 'arrived' tap. The trace's longest qualifying in-geofence run is 240 seconds, from 2026-09-23T15:12:50 to 15:16:50, and its accumulated in-geofence dwell is 230 seconds - a shortfall of 70 seconds. Because the driver did not hold position for the required minimum, limb (c) is broken and the fee is not chargeable under this clause.

POL-NS-06 then directs the remedy: where the effective in-geofence dwell is shorter than the POL-NS-01 minimum for the zone class, the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider answered messages. Required 300 seconds for STANDARD, measured 240 seconds (accumulated 230), shortfall 70 seconds as computed on the trace. The only qualification, limb (i) accumulation, is unavailable here: EV-ADVIS-00708-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 and issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, and POL-NS-06(i) requires a present and populated advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT before separate in-geofence intervals may be summed. No advisory exists, so nothing bridges the shortfall and nothing excuses it. The charge is refunded in full.

Limb (d) of POL-NS-01 fails as well. The trip record shows cancellation_reason_code null, cancelled_by null, cancelled_at null and status COMPLETED. There is no termination by the driver on RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT, and no boarding event is recorded anywhere on the trip. The driver's own counterparty statement does not assert that anyone boarded - it says the passengers 'were confused and walked away'. With limb (d) unsatisfied, no no-show fee is chargeable under POL-NS-01 at all, and the charge taken from the rider cannot stand as an itemised cancellation fee.

POL-NS-04 independently exonerates the rider and refunds the fee in full with no driver compensation payable. Limb (a): the chat log holds the rider's message sent at 2026-09-23T15:16:50 - 'My parents are still at the pickup. Did anyone board?' - which is both a statement of the riders' position and a request for the driver's position, and it was sent while the driver was still inside the geofence, his qualifying run ending at the same moment. Limb (b): the driver neither replied in the chat within 120 seconds of that message nor placed any in-app voice call - trip_record.in_app_calls is empty - before the trip ended at 15:20:40. Limb (c) cannot be run at all because the trace carries no rider track (rider_fix_count 0), and POL-NS-04 makes an absent rider track UNDECIDABLE and neutral: it is expressly neither satisfied nor failed, and the Judge must not infer from it that the rider was elsewhere. On limbs (a) and (b), with (c) neutral, the fee is refunded in full.

The sum actually taken is not a no-show fee, and I disclose the impairment rather than present it clean: EV-FARE-00708 carries weight_multiplier 0.6 and issue code UNVERIFIED_SOURCE (MAJOR) - a manually transcribed rider payment screen with no independent ledger corroboration, which the driver also disputes. On its face it shows cancellation_fee 0.00 alongside total_charged 26.00, composed of base_fare 3.80, distance_fare 14.90, time_fare 6.50 and platform_fee 0.80: a completed-trip fare, not a cancellation fee, and its own money derivation reports a schedule fee of 4.00 against a fee charged of 0.00. Even on the driver's best case, the chargeable no-show fee for a STANDARD RYDE_X trip under POL-NS-01 and fee_schedule.resolution_rule is the greater of the zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00) - SGD 4.00. The rider should not be left carrying a completed-trip fare for a trip on which no passenger boarded.

In the alternative, if the amount cannot be fixed because the only ledger for it is the impaired, unverified fare screen that both parties dispute, the case cannot be decided on the money and must escalate under POL-NS-09: the sole evidence for the deciding amount is impaired and the conflict is unresolved by any clause. POL-GEN-02 permits ESCALATE where a deciding fact rests solely on an artifact at or below weight 0.65, as here. Escalation holds the disputed SGD 26 rather than collecting or refunding it, so the rider is not left carrying a charge the platform cannot substantiate. Either way the rider should not bear this charge.

ledger.claim: The rider asks the tribunal to return 'this platform charge', but no no-show fee was ever charged on this trip. EV-FARE-00708 records cancellation_fee 0.00 and the derived money block records fee_charged 0.00, while the SGD 26.00 is made up of base fare 3.80 + distance fare 14.90 + time fare 6.50 + platform fee 0.80 on a trip that EV-TRIP-00708 shows as COMPLETED. POL-NS-01 licenses only NO_ACTION or DRIVER_COMPENSATION, and POL-NS-06 refunds the cancellation-fee line and nothing else ('refund the cancellation-fee line only, not any booking or platform fee'); where there is no cancellation-fee line there is nothing for the no-show policy to return to the rider. EV-FARE-00708 is impaired - weight 0.6, issue code UNVERIFIED_SOURCE - and I rely on it only for the arithmetic it records.

The rider's own filing concedes that the only proof of the disputed amount is 'a manually transcribed payment screen, not a verified ledger export', and the admissibility pre-pass tagged EV-FARE-00708 IMPAIRED with issue code UNVERIFIED_SOURCE at weight 0.6. Under POL-GEN-02 an artifact below 0.70 that is the sole carrier of a deciding fact caps confidence beneath the platform-wide 0.70 floor, so the rider's own evidence cannot carry a refund against the driver; the driver has expressly disputed this same artifact in his statement.

The driver did arrive and hold at the pickup. EV-GPS-00708 records 25 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius in a single continuous in-geofence run of 240 seconds, with a minimum recorded distance to the pickup pin of 1.24 m. This is a driver who was physically present at the pickup point and waited there - not a driver who never came.

The arrival marker is not a false arrival under POL-NS-05. The trace's closest approach to the pin is 1.24 m, the in-geofence fixes report 0.0 kph, and nothing in EV-GPS-00708 places the driver more than 300 m from the pickup pin, or travelling at 15 km/h or above, at the moment the marker was set. The false-arrival refund route is not open on this record and no false-arrival referral can be entered against the driver.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider. The single chat message was sent at 15:16:50, ten seconds AFTER the trip started at 15:16:40, so it was not sent 'during the waiting window' as limb (a) requires; and limb (c) is undecidable because EV-GPS-00708 carries no rider track at all (rider_fix_count 0), which POL-NS-04 expressly treats as neutral rather than satisfied. With limb (a) not made out and limb (c) not made out, the clause does not apply and the dispute is decided under POL-NS-01.

The present state of this trip is a charge of SGD 26.00 with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. On this record the rider's claim is not supported: no cancellation fee exists to refund and the only evidence of the amount is impaired and disputed. Under POL-GEN-03 the disposition is NO_ACTION, which leaves the charge exactly as it presently stands. EV-FARE-00708 is impaired - weight 0.6, issue code UNVERIFIED_SOURCE - and I cite it only for the recorded payment state.

If the tribunal concludes it cannot fix the disputed amount on the evidence before it, the outcome should still not be a refund. The sole artifact carrying the amount, EV-FARE-00708, is impaired (weight 0.6, issue code UNVERIFIED_SOURCE) and is disputed by the driver, so the amount should be placed on hold for human review under POL-NS-09 rather than returned. Escalation holds the disputed amount; it does not refund it.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider: the factual core of your account is supported. The driver's own statement concedes the passengers never boarded ('the passengers were confused and walked away'), and your 15:16:50 in-app message ('My parents are still at the pickup. Did anyone board?') is consistent with it. On the no-show tests the driver's own telemetry fails as well: EV-GPS-00708 gives a longest continuous in-geofence run of 240 seconds against the 300-second STANDARD minimum (fee_schedule.minimum_dwell_sec for trip_record.pickup_zone_class = STANDARD), a 70-second shortfall, so POL-NS-01 limb (c) is broken; and EV-TRIP-00708 records cancellation_reason_code, cancelled_by and cancelled_at all null with status COMPLETED, so limb (d) is broken too. No cancellation fee is chargeable. Your POL-NS-04 argument is rejected: your message was sent at 15:16:50, ten seconds AFTER the trip started at 15:16:40 and after the waiting window (arrival 15:12:40 to start 15:16:40) had closed, so limb (a) is not made out; limb (c) is undecidable and neutral because EV-GPS-00708 carries no rider track (rider_fix_count 0). But this does not, by itself, return your money: POL-NS-06 and POL-NS-04 refund the cancellation-fee line only, and the fare breakdown records cancellation_fee 0.00. To the driver: your point that no no-show fee was ever charged is well taken, as are your arrival and no-false-marker points (closest approach 1.24 m, 25 qualifying fixes, nothing over 300 m or at 15 km/h at the marker). But the character and amount of the contested SGD 26.00 rest entirely on EV-FARE-00708, and that artifact is impaired: weight_multiplier 0.6, issue code UNVERIFIED_SOURCE (a manually transcribed payment screen with no ledger corroboration), which you yourself dispute. EV-TRIP-00708 and EV-GPS-00708 (both weight 1.0) establish the arrival, dwell and completion facts; neither carries the charge. The deciding fact is therefore carried solely by evidence at 0.6 — below the 0.65 automatic-escalation threshold and below the 0.70 platform floor — so my confidence is capped at 0.6 and is below the floor. The case escalates under POL-NS-09(a), and the sole-evidence impairment engages POL-NS-09(e) read with POL-NS-08; the fare breakdown also fails POL-NS-08(d) on its face (cancellation-fee line 0.00 against a fee_schedule resolution-rule amount of SGD 4.00 for a STANDARD RYDE_X trip). This is not a finding for either side. The disputed SGD 26.00 is held, not collected or refunded, while review is pending. The reviewer's open questions: fix the true character and amount of the SGD 26.00 — is it a completed-trip fare (base fare 3.80 + distance fare 14.90 + time fare 6.50 + platform fee 0.80 = 26.00, as the fare breakdown records) or a no-show charge; whether it should stand at all given that no passenger boarded a trip the platform nevertheless marked COMPLETED; and what became of the waiting-period and termination handling on this trip.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and 3 of the 4 drafts agreed on this ruling, so it is carried, not unanimous (vote agreement 0.75).
